Am a student of IMO state university Owerri Nigeria, I returned back home for holiday, after going through a lot in the previous semester.
 I returned back home thinking I will be able to gather enough money and resources for the coming semester, but funny enough the holiday is almost over and here am I still almost with nothing, just thinking on how I can go about it because I have many things to take care of in the coming semester, I have text books to purchase, my clothes are almost faded out I need to get some, I have some outstanding payment to pay both concerning my faculty dues and departmental clearance. 
  I have tried my best to avoid overthinking because I found out that it only ends up someone in depression and mental illness. " Overthinking can't solve a problem"
 I suggest to myself instead of harboring it alone it's better I speak out, and try in my little way to help myself. 
 One important truth I understand about life is that there is time and season for everything in life. 



![1725265261173.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXRS9LC7LeeZCAJMefGoX27uhbS9jYeZ3dHzLVjFFCeDM/1725265261173.jpg)



 my humble pleading to you out there, in anyway or form you can help. 
 Your upvote and prayers will definitely go a long way.🥹🥹
 I sincerely appreciate your understanding.🙏🙏🙏

![Polish_20241117_230912442.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mayifiestas/AKSd3QigAExYEbrGHSx7eDgfr3MpSgvoAFb312KorrWDLi8hZkywT22KonvQ5YP.jpg)
#
Here is the proposal for you to vote.
https://peakd.com/me/proposals/326
Greetings my loves, I hope you are well, well, I have become a nervous wreck and you may wonder why? Well, a few days ago we had the opportunity to introduce a project in the DHF in order to obtain the necessary help that will allow us to achieve the urgent spine operation that my husband needs and thus recover his health and be able to return to our lives.
There have been many reactions to this, some good, others not so good, but for the most part we have received expressions of support and solidarity as the family that we are in hive, which makes us remain optimistic with the approval of the proposal, well my loves I will speak from the bottom of my heart.
![Polish_20241117_211334836.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mayifiestas/EokhSgx51KtRkzrhX3xB1AwYYQW8UJHsefCVi9oYAVJt1b3pGUxvH8G9Kha6tRJEcEm.jpg)
We have been a year and almost two months going through this via crucis with the health of my husband @gilliatt I had never dared to ask the DHF for anything, on the contrary for three continuous years both my husband and I dedicated ourselves to work for our ecosystem, with our own resources through a project we call @lacasitahive, a project where my husband was the main engine, without help from anyone we made #hive visible to a good number of people in our state Sucre, we dared to meet with actors and sectors We gave talks in many places, but undoubtedly we had to face a beautiful challenge, and we dared, we were invited to give a talk about our ecosystem as guests of honor at the University Simon Rodriguez Sucre core, held in the auditorium of the theater Luis Mariano Rivera, the main theater of our state Sucre, before a room full of more than 300 people, and we took the challenge and took support material, advertising and left the name of our blockchain very high, from there came the commitment to give talks about the hive ecosystem in all the nuclei of this university and we did this all with our own resources, we traveled to different places of our state, we traveled to different places of our country, we took the challenge and we took the material of support, advertising and we left the name of our blockchain very high, from there came the commitment to give talks about the hive ecosystem in all the nuclei of this university and this all we did with our own resources, we traveled to different places of our Sucre state to publicize #hive , and although we reached different agreements we could not be 100% because of my husband's accident, but rest assured that we will fulfill them when his health is recovered.
[Post reference](https://peakd.com/hive-156444/@lacasitahive/esp-engreporte-de-actividades-de-lacasitahive) [Post reference](https://peakd.com/hive-156444/@lacasitahive/charla-de-introduccion-al-ecosistema-hive-proteccion-civil) [Post reference](https://peakd.com/hive-189306/@gilliatt/rzlungwg)
Everything we did was without a single penny of hive, and we did it because we love this blockchain and we wanted everyone to know about the benefits of this wonderful ecosystem to which we belong for almost 5 years, and we did everything to contribute our bit to our home in #web3, during this year, in different opportunities I published my husband's health problem and very few seemed to care about it, not to worry about it I expected everyone to rush to my aid, I was simply looking for a word of support that came only from a few whom I thank from the bottom of my heart.
![Polish_20241117_211318023.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mayifiestas/23t7xHQCWhzcy9WZ4TG8P8nCMWZT5SB1AQwezxPz77KZgEPthvnz57HZJD8PRpQZRCc8w.jpg)
Still I followed my process almost in silence, and I say my process, because my husband did not feel well enough to make publications or anything like that, the months went by and I was publishing my experience with the different treatments and neurosurgeons who treated my husband, I was telling everything and less and less people supported me, and partly I understand it, I know that everyone has their own problems, I was just looking for a little help, sometimes even just an outlet, and this support only came from a few.
I have never asked for help for anything and this is the first time I do it, so gentlemen before passing judgment put your hand on your heart, think that I am not asking for help to fulfill a whim, it is about restoring the health of a wonderful human being, that during the 30 years that we have been together the only thing I have seen from him, I certainly understand and I am clear that the DHF funds are not for this type of expenses, I have always known that, but it is also true that in life there comes a time to break the rules and even more so when it is a medical emergency, as in our case.
I did not make a proposal to go on a trip, much less for a banal expense, I came to ask for help, it could be said that out of humanity, before criticizing and not supporting, I invite you to put yourself in my shoes, just for a day, I do not ask much, my day is spent between household chores, besides helping my husband to bathe, do the shopping, take walks around the city looking for medicines, taking my husband to and from therapies and consultations, I take walks around the city looking for medicines, taking my husband to and from therapies and consultations, and in the early morning I find the time to practice the art of artistic makeup that I use as a way to drain, in addition to fulfilling my orders of piñateria and decoration which is what I am currently engaged and my only income, despite having two university degrees.
![PXL_20241002_092038536.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mayifiestas/23xekB6TuA4KxyYpDvG3pnAjLER1Kgp4w52koSa3FK5eC9kLJdtZU3mVkLX9DhMAUPjj8.jpg)
And then there is the emotional part, think about all that I have to endure: seeing my husband cry, screaming in pain because no medicine calms his pain, working with him so that he does not fall into depression, because it is not easy to go from being an active, independent person to depend on another even for the most basic things like bathing, I must battle daily not to cry, not to collapse in front of him, because I am his only support, for a day Put yourselves in my shoes, try to be strong when you want to shout, try to put yourselves in my shoes when I have no money to buy medicines because they are very expensive and every two weeks I spend $120 that I have to work hard to earn, put yourselves in my shoes before criticizing and remember that I am just an ordinary human being, remember also that what I ask you today is to vote for this proposal to recover our lives, those that a year and two months ago we had to put on pause.
![PXL_20240704_130935204.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mayifiestas/23zS5XDX33wAByvrWJwavEsn71K3PsAQoi1S6uTNWVYFUsnFFam8C5zu9ZuQweL6WYViZ.jpg)
I ask you with all my heart to vote for this proposal, to have a ray of illusion this Christmas, I want to have a little bit of peace, physical but above all mental, why I invite you to vote for this proposal? Because I want my husband to be able to walk, to go back to being that wonderful person who went through life supporting everyone who needs him, singing, writing stories and poetry, I ask you above all that you have the ability to give me that vote to help approve the proposal that you make an exception and vote because you will not regret it, you who have in your hands enough power to vote and to to give life back to someone who showed love to this ecosystem, but above all I ask you to vote for this proposal because you are a wonderful human being.
What do you say you join those of us who do help our brother when he is in trouble?

Saludos mis amores, espero que se encuentren bien, bueno yo convertida en un manojo de nervios y ustedes se preguntaran porque? Pues bien, hace ya unos pocos días tuvimos la oportunidad de introducir un proyecto en el DHF con la finalidad de obtener una ayuda necesaria que nos permita lograr la operación de columna tan urgente que amerita mi esposo y así de esta manera recobrar su salud y poder regresar a nuestra vidas.
Muchas han sido las reacciones al respecto, unas buenas otras no tan buenas, pero en su gran mayoría hemos recibido manifestaciones de apoyo y solidaridad como la familia que somos en hive, lo que nos hace mantenernos optimistas con la aprobación de la propuesta, pues bien mis amores les voy hablar desde el fondo de mi corazón.
![Polish_20241117_211334836.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mayifiestas/EokhSgx51KtRkzrhX3xB1AwYYQW8UJHsefCVi9oYAVJt1b3pGUxvH8G9Kha6tRJEcEm.jpg)
Llevamos un año y casi dos meses atravesando por este vía crucis con la salud de mi esposo @gilliatt nunca me había atrevido a pedirle al DHF nada, muy por el contrario durante tres años continuos tanto mi esposo, como mi persona nos dedicamos a trabajar en pro de nuestro ecosistema, con recursos propios a través de un proyecto que llamamos @lacasitahive, proyecto dónde mi esposo era el principal motor, sin ayuda de nadie hicimos que #hive fuese visible a una buena cantidad de personas en nuestro estado Sucre, nos atrevimos a reunirnos con actores y sectores importantes de nuestro estado Sucre para lograr cosas bonitas que en su momento se fueron consolidando en materia de hive, dimos charlas en muchísimos sitios, pero sin lugar a dudas nos tocó enfrentar un reto bellísimo, y nos atrevimos, fuimos invitados a dar una charla sobre nuestro ecosistema como invitados de honor en la Universidad Simón Rodríguez núcleo de Sucre, realizada en el auditorio del teatro Luis Mariano Rivera, el principal teatro de nuestro estado Sucre, ante una sala llena de más de 300 personas, y asumimos el reto y llevamos material de apoyo, publicidad y dejamos el nombre de nuestra blockchain muy en alto, de allí surgió el compromiso de dar charlas sobre el ecosistema hive en todos los núcleos de esta universidad y esto todo lo hicimos con recursos propios, viajamos a diferentes lugares de nuestro estado Sucre para dar a conocer a #hive , y aunque llegamos a diferentes acuerdos no se pudieron concretar al 100% por el accidente de mi esposo, Pero tengan por seguro que los vamos a cumplir cuando ya su salud esté recuperada.
[Post referencia](https://peakd.com/hive-156444/@lacasitahive/esp-engreporte-de-actividades-de-lacasitahive) [Post referencia](https://peakd.com/hive-156444/@lacasitahive/charla-de-introduccion-al-ecosistema-hive-proteccion-civil) [Post referencia](https://peakd.com/hive-189306/@gilliatt/rzlungwg)
Todo lo que hicimos fue sin un solo centavo de hive, y lo hicimos porque amamos esta blockchain y quisimos que todos conocieran de las bondades de este ecosistema maravilloso al cual pertenecemos desde hace casi 5 años, y todo lo hicimos para aportar nuestro granito de arena a nuestra casa en #web3, durante este año, en diferentes oportunidades publique el problema de salud de mi esposo y simplemente a muy pocos pareció importarle, ojo no esperaba que todos corrieran en mi ayuda, simplemente buscaba una palabra de apoyo que llegó solo de unos pocos a los que les agradezco con el corazón.
![Polish_20241117_211318023.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mayifiestas/23t7xHQCWhzcy9WZ4TG8P8nCMWZT5SB1AQwezxPz77KZgEPthvnz57HZJD8PRpQZRCc8w.jpg)
Aún así seguí mi proceso casi en silencio, y digo mi proceso, porque mi esposo no se sentía bien como para hacer publicaciones ni nada así, los meses fueron pasando y fui publicando como fue mi experiencia con los diferentes tratamientos y neurocirujanos que trataban a mi esposo, fui relatando todo y cada vez eran menos los que me apoyaban, y en parte lo entiendo, se que cada quien tiene sus propios problemas, yo solo buscaba un poco de ayuda, a veces incluso solo un desahogo, y este apoyo solo llegó de unos pocos.
Nunca he pedido ayuda para nada y es la primera vez que lo hago, así que señores antes de emitir juicio ponganse la mano en el corazón, piensen que no estoy pidiendo ayuda para cumplir un capricho, se trata de devolverle la salud a un ser humano maravilloso, que durante los 30 años que llevamos juntos lo único que he visto de él, es que ayuda a todo el que puede, incluso por encima de su propio bienestar, ciertamente comprendo y tengo claro que los fondos del DHF no son para este tipo de gastos, eso lo tengo bien claro, siempre lo he sabido, pero también es cierto que en la vida llega el momento de romper las reglas y más cuando se trata de una emergencia médica, como lo es nuestro caso.
Yo no hice una propuesta para irme de viaje, mucho menos para un gasto banal, yo acudí a pedir una ayuda podría decirse que por humanidad, antes de criticar y no apoyar, los invito a ponerse en mis zapatos, solo por un día, no les pido mucho, mi día transcurre entre quehaceres del hogar, además de ayudar a mí esposo a bañarse, hacer las compras, hacer paseos por toda la ciudad buscando medicinas, llevando y trayendo a mi esposo de terapias y consultas, ya en la madrugada busco el tiempo para practicar el arte del maquillaje artístico que lo utilizo como forma de drenar, además de cumplir con mis encargos de piñateria y decoración que es a lo que me dedico actualmente y mi único ingreso, a pesar de tener dos títulos universitarios.
![PXL_20241002_092038536.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mayifiestas/23xekB6TuA4KxyYpDvG3pnAjLER1Kgp4w52koSa3FK5eC9kLJdtZU3mVkLX9DhMAUPjj8.jpg)
Y bueno luego está la parte anímica, pónganse a pensar todo lo que aguanto: ver a mi esposo llorar, gritar de dolor porque ningún medicamento le calma el dolor, trabajar con él para que no caiga en depresión, porque no es nada fácil pasar de ser una persona activa, independiente a depender de otra incluso para las cosas más básicas como bañarse, debo batallar a diario por no llorar, por no derrumbarme delante de él, porque soy su único apoyo, por un dia pónganse en mis zapatos, traten de ser fuertes cuando lo que quieren es gritar, traten de ponerse mis zapatos cuando no tengo dinero para comprar los medicamentos porque son bien costosos y cada dos semanas gasto 120$ que debo trabajar bien duro para ganarlos, pónganse en mis zapatos antes de criticar y recuerden que solo soy un ser humano común y corriente, recuerden también que lo que hoy les pido es que voten por esta propuesta para poder recobrar nuestra vidas, esas que hace un año y dos meses tuvimos que poner en pausa.
![PXL_20240704_130935204.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mayifiestas/23zS5XDX33wAByvrWJwavEsn71K3PsAQoi1S6uTNWVYFUsnFFam8C5zu9ZuQweL6WYViZ.jpg)
Te pido de todo corazón votes por esta propuesta, para tener un rayito de ilusión estás navidades, quiero tener un poquito de paz, física Pero sobretodo mental, ¿Porqué te invito a votar está propuesta? Porque quiero que mi esposo pueda caminar, pueda volver a ser esa persona maravillosa que iba por la vida apoyando a todo el que necesitará de él, cantando, escribiendo cuentos y poesías, te pido por sobretodo a ti que tienes la capacidad de darme ese voto que ayude a aprobar la propuesta que hagas una excepción y votes porque no te vas arrepentir, a ti que tienes en tus manos el poder suficiente de votar y de devolverle la vida a alguien que demostró querer a este ecosistema, pero sobretodo te pido votes estas propuesta porque eres un ser humano maravilloso.
¿Que dices te sumas a los que si ayudamos al hermano cuando está en desgracia?

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSB7i2Le2UCTaKx6Fyu937o35hoTiSJnqqSpvSaLdHHEa/img_20241117_wa0002.jpg)

Growing up under disciplinarian parents, I never grasped the concept of tipping. To me, it seemed unethical, unnecessary and downright wrong. My parents instilled in me the importance of honesty, hard work and earning rewards through merit. However, reality soon hit hard, challenging my perceptions.

During my final year in university, I encountered a harsh lesson. Despite submitting my thesis on time, my result wasn't processed for Senate approval. Fellow students received congratulations on their completion, while I wasn't. I was confused and concerned, I rushed to the department to inquire.
A student hinted that I needed to "appreciate" the Faculty secretary. I was appalled, wondering if bribery had become an accepted norm. Reluctantly, I offered a gift, and miraculously, my result was processed. This experience left a sour taste.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcAJBqsGf4kpyR7KykVMLrB5CCnQ5tZd9CDmMA5qGFk94/img_20240702_wa0008.jpg)

This incident mirrored my father's ordeal. After retiring, he eagerly awaited government benefits. Upon discovering his name omitted from the beneficiaries' list, we sought assistance. An elderly woman advised us to "grease the wheels" with a 10% tip. We refused at first but hunger was teaching us the lesson. However, we reluctantly complied, feeling coerced.

These incidents exposed me to the harsh realities of corruption and the expectation of bribery. My disciplinarian upbringing hadn't prepared me for this. I've learned to navigate these challenges, but the moral implications linger. Now, I question the fairness of systems where favors and bribes dictate outcomes. Has our society lost sight of integrity? Are honesty and hard work no longer enough?
These experiences have taught me resilience, adaptability and the importance of understanding cultural nuances. In fact, it has really helped me in my business. My business entail working with several truck drivers. So, I do tip them regularly to have my goods delivered to the customers, if not I would see no driver and they would prefer to be working for my competitors who understand the tipping culture.
Nevertheless, I still yearn for a world where meritocracy prevails. 
All photos were taken by me.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdwHTMCBFarTWTbF7KpC2tAry7MyiLXpBXiwCtnz4nw7Q/img_0.03045963907926931.jpg)

Greetings to my hive family around the world. The word tipping is a very strong word that has to do with paying ones way through to get what you wanted or even what you deserve. So, for this reason, tipping is  now part of our culture in this part of the world. I have engaged in tipping people just to scale through hurdles. Although to some, it's against moral but to someone like me, it's a way of appreciating people's efforts.

Sometime ago, when  I was to collect my late mum gratuity  from a state government in Nigeria was my first time of tipping people. Then, I didn't know anything about the system and I thought everything will follow due process and as an advocate of due process, I went home to relax expecting the outcome of all the processes we have passed through but all to no avail , Nothing came out as expected. It's as a result of this that led me to informing a family friend at the ministry of finance,  when he heard about the happenings, he laughed and parted me at my back, saying look at you, in this system, nothing goes for nothing, it's then I asked him what he meant and he replied by saying " you have to tip them before you get what you want or deserve". I was amazed and vow not do such within myself, but when I realized it's not going to work, I went to the ministry to look into the matter as well and in the process,  one of the beneficiaries called be aside and told me what to do to fasten the process. It's then I surrendered and tipped then with 5,000 naira and within the same week, everything was settled and I collected my late mum gratuity check and even, if there's any other development as regard the gratuity,  those people will still call to keep me updated. This is because we were not paid everything at once.See my tipping in action.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZRFVYPXAsXJiDcJswAuvEZFkxN1wGubRruauo75wdsAC/img_0.5946478603903846.jpg)

Another scenario was on my supply business, I'm into the supply of granite and stone dust and as a supplier,  for those people at the quarry to help you load ur granite using their pay loader, , you have to tip them most especially the payloader operators, even for the gate man to open the gate for you, you have to tip them, at the scale tipping is not forbidden. The driver is another person you must not joke with and this is because without him being tipped, he may say the truck has a mechanical fault just to delay you from getting to your destination on time. What of the site engineers? These people have their own way of demanding money from suppliers and not only them, we still have the casual labor looking for you to tip them. why? Coz this are the people that will recommend what you have brought or supplied to the chief engineer, it's what they say that the engineer on site will believe.  If they say it's full then it's full, if they say it's big or small then it's.  So for you as a supplier to thrive in the business,  you must not joke with tipping. It's one of the chain of supplying. Well as I said earlier,  it's one of the way of appreciating people. Thanks for reading. 

All photos are mine.

Greetings!
_____

Around the month of March this year, our compound was growing grasses sporadically, and none of us in the compound were ready to clear them. Yes, I was among them. It was actually laziness that held me back. One day, I met some young boys, around the ages of 15 to 17 years, who went about with cutlasses seeking people to employ them to clear grasses in their compounds. I engaged them to clear the grasses in our compound, and when I asked them about their charge, they humbly said I should pay them 1,000 naira. I didn't argue; I let them work, and when they were done, I handed over 2,000 naira. They were shocked and started thanking me profusely.

That’s how I approach my tipping culture: it comes willingly, to people who need it, and never as a show-off. I added an extra 1,000 naira to their requested fee because I saw that they needed it, and I knew it would make them happy. Also, the work—farm work—is genuinely hard.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNb7GCqzm9WuinFcFN98PwQF2Cczw7nNsnHJNeL1aLaeD/1001468792.jpg)


Giving, in general, is something that should come from the heart, not be done forcefully, and never as a show-off thing, just like this era has made showing off in giving a norm. There’s nothing bad about giving, but tipping, especially, is something that one should do out of free will and only when necessary. It’s not something one should borrow money to do just to feel included or recognized. 

You know, I’ve been to different occasions, especially birthdays, where people give money to the celebrant, and the MC showers praises on them. As a result, those who don’t give or don’t give large amounts are looked down upon. I hate such scenarios and frown at them so badly. It’s one of the reasons I don’t attend certain birthday celebrations because birthdays are meant for love and merriment, not as a ground for money donations.

Whenever I’m going out, I make sure I have cash with me because I don’t know what scenario might pop up along the way or who I might need to help. I hate situations where I meet someone in dire need and can’t offer financial help. I don’t mean beggars on the street or around bus terminals, no. I mean scenarios like meeting an accident victim and deciding to render help.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTUmaSZiUwcKDj3hsn5LPESsJeRw2KBtqLRHxWroPWYVB/1001468791.jpg)


I remember a certain period during the days I was at home. I went on an errand to a faraway place, and my bicycle got damaged beyond my control. I became stranded on the road and couldn’t afford to stop a motorcycle to carry me and the bicycle back home. My parents weren’t at home, and I couldn’t board a bike on credit, knowing there would be no one at home to pay when I arrived. 

A good Samaritan showed up, stopped a bike, and paid the bikeman to transport both me and the spoilt bicycle back home. I can never forget that day.

Thanks for reading.
_____

😍😘🙏🤗💪👧🙌👨👩👧😛
#
Hola compañeros, bendiciones a todos los apasionados por la comida. El día de hoy me complace compartirles el armado de unas ricas granolas, con motivo a que necesito vender un producto que me ayude a recolectar dinero, para poder operarme el seno izquierdo, motivo a un adenoma benigno. Esa operación está organizada Dios mediante para 26 de noviembre de este año 2024, pero como no cuento con los recursos económicos, pensé que haciendo este producto, ayudaría aportar a los 200 $ que necesito en total para poder optar por la operación. Para lograr mi fin, me dirigí a un supermercado, de la ciudad de Cumaná, a comprar un paquete de granola que sería mi base, la cual contiene: Coco, Avena sin gluten, Maní, Pasas y Ajonjolí; más varios envases de una variedad de frutos secos para añadir a las granolas: Maní dulce, Maní con Ajonjolí y Merey; y un paquete de Malvaviscos. Una vez llegue a casa, me puse analizar, junto a mi esposo, cuantos gramos tendría cada granola, y una vez hecho los cálculos saldrían más o menos 14. Gracias a Dios ya contaba con las bolsas. La elección de los ingredientes seleccionados fueron porque además de ser ricos, quería armar granolas coloridas, originales y diferentes, para complacer el paladar de quienes tenga la fortuna de probarlas y darse un gusto, ya que en ocasiones andamos con ansiedad por el ritmo de vida y este tipo de snack ayuda a calmarnos.
# >
Hello colleagues, blessings to all those passionate about food. Today I am pleased to share with you the assembly of some delicious granolas, because I need to sell a product that will help me to raise money to be able to operate on my left breast, due to a benign adenoma. That operation is organized God willing for November 26th of this year 2024, but as I do not have the economic resources, I thought that by making this product, I would help to contribute to the 200 $ that I need in total to be able to opt for the operation. To achieve my goal, I went to a supermarket in the city of Cumaná, to buy a package of granola that would be my base, which contains: Coconut, Gluten Free Oats, Peanuts, Raisins and Sesame; plus several containers of a variety of nuts to add to the granola: Sweet Peanuts, Peanuts with Sesame and Merey; and a package of Marshmallows. Once I got home, I started analyzing, together with my husband, how many grams each granola would have, and once I did the calculations, it came out to be about 14. The choice of the selected ingredients was because besides being tasty, I wanted to make colorful, original and different granolas, to please the palate of those who have the fortune to try them and treat themselves, because sometimes we are anxious because of the pace of life and this type of snack helps to calm us down.
#
![d8295171-ec65-4867-9d1d-5fa05f231881.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dorimarval/23tH3MJHdtMjL4CiFdiWWPQbFoNuwxr4geCQTNxZNfv2t318YZfTKZrFUHRtfRe63tJ6v.jpeg)

Ingredientes: 1) Un paquete de Granola 500 gramos. 2) Un envase de 235 gramos de Maní dulce. 3) Un envase de 205 gramos de Maní con Ajonjolí. 4) Un envase de 205 gramos de Merey. 5) Un paquete de 100 gramos de Malvaviscos. 6) 14 bolsas. Equipos, Utensilios e Instrumentos: 1) Un Peso electrónico. 2) Una pinza. 3) Una cuchara grande. 4) Una tijera. 5) Un tirro transparente. 6) Un lapicero. 7) Una Hoja de anotación.
# >
Ingredients: Ingredients: 1) One 500 gram package of Granola. 2) One 235 grams package of sweet peanuts. 3) One 205 grams package of Peanuts with Sesame. 4) One 205 gram package of Merey. 5) One 100 grams package of marshmallows. 6) 14 bags. Equipment, Utensils and Instruments: 1) One Electronic weight. 2) One clamp. 3) One large spoon. 4) One scissors. 5) A transparent strip. 6) A pencil. 7) A note sheet.
#
![8d725985-8e7e-4b17-a9b2-0334dd40bba0.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dorimarval/EoeExRxdSiA8CZgz5dze1fTT8fsy5VR5ZuLtdtgu6REDTcPh3PLT7khqH1HXzTEcCDn.jpeg)

😍😘🙏🤗💪👧🙌👨👩👧😛
#
El proceso del armado de las granolas, inicio abriendo una de las bolsas y con la ayuda de la pinza agregue 33 gramos de granola, más 15 gramos de maní dulce, después 13 gramos de maní con ajonjolí, y luego anexe 13 gramos de merey y finalmente los 7 gramos de malvaviscos. Cabe destacar, que cada ingrediente los pesaba con la ayuda del peso electrónico y cuando añadía un nuevo ingrediente los sumaba con el que ya estaba, hasta lograr obtener los 81 gramos de cada granola. Debo admitir que con la pinza se me hizo difícil agregar los ingredientes, así que continúe usando la cuchara grande. Más adelante, para agilizar el armado de las granolas, se me ocurrió llenar cada bolsa restante con el primer ingrediente y una vez todas las bolsas llenas, continuaba con el siguiente ingrediente y así repetía el proceso con las demás, hasta obtener la bolsa llena con todos los ingredientes, y pesarán los 81 gramos. Una vez las granolas armadas, le saqué el aire a cada bolsa y la fui doblando, hasta llegar al producto, y con el tirro de plástico iba sacando trozos y los cortaba con la tijera, para pagárselo a los bordes de los dobles de la bolsa. El resultado me gusto mucho, las granolas se ven llamativas, pero sobre todo se sorprenderán con el sabor, ya que se sentirá en el paladar un contraste entre dulce y salado.
# >
The process of assembling the granolas began by opening one of the bags and with the help of the tweezers I added 33 grams of granola, plus 15 grams of sweet peanuts, then 13 grams of peanuts with sesame seeds, then 13 grams of cashews and finally 7 grams of marshmallows. It should be noted that I weighed each ingredient with the help of the electronic weight and when I added a new ingredient I added it to the one that was already there, until I obtained 81 grams of each granola. I must admit that with the tongs it was difficult to add the ingredients, so I continued using the large spoon. Later, to speed up the assembly of the granolas, it occurred to me to fill each remaining bag with the first ingredient and once all the bags were filled, I continued with the next ingredient and so I repeated the process with the others, until the bag was filled with all the ingredients, and the 81 grams were weighed. Once the granolas were assembled, I took the air out of each bag and folded it, until I reached the product, and with the plastic strip I took out pieces and cut them with the scissors, to pay them to the edges of the doubles of the bag. I liked the result very much, the granolas look striking, but above all you will be surprised with the flavor, since you will feel a contrast between sweet and salty on the palate.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWkKF4RDCJMyiN7Vv52iAa4yd4cSuB7wwCrnu6cpBycqc/charity_donation.png) https://images.ecency.com/DQmSqzmqSqxuRNbpX9wqjmKyhXH58FYwcK3wXaa32qnHugB/divider.png
>
It takes one to get sick but the whole community to heal.
Hey, this is @rashed.ifte with a different post than we normally make in our community. You should already understand it, seeing the thumbnail. A sister needs our help, YOUR help. I noticed @worldmappin publishing a post about supporting their beloved team member @ybanezkim26. You may read that post of worldmappin [here](https://peakd.com/hive-163772/@worldmappin/lets-support-our-beloved-team-member-ybanezkim26). Many of you may know ybanezkim26 who has been actively curating travel posts for pinmapple (former community name of worldmappin) for a long time and I read some of his travel posts before. Normally, he doesn't know me but I know him, thanks to HIVE. https://images.ecency.com/DQmSqzmqSqxuRNbpX9wqjmKyhXH58FYwcK3wXaa32qnHugB/divider.png His sister got kidney nephritis and has been in the ICU of a hospital for some days now. He published a post recently with the update about his sister that you can find [here](https://peakd.com/hive-188409/@ybanezkim26/life-update-my-sisters-still-in-icu). *"First her kidney was attacked by her immune system causing Stage 3 renal failure, then her heart and she had a heart attack during the time we were in the emergency room, then her lungs were filled with fluid to the point that she was internally drowning. Now, she's having seizures and it might still be caused by her lupus. She will be scheduled for an MRI (magnetic resonance imaging) scan tomorrow. She had her EEG (electroencephalogram) earlier to monitor her brain activity. That was after her seizures four times"* - ybanezkim26. I got really sad reading the part where he talked about his sister getting seizures and then *"I witnessed twice the life in her eyes slowly drifting away"*. I can't imagine witnessing a loved one in such a condition. BTW, they need our help, YOUR help. Her insurance coverage ended on the second day in the ICU and she needs our help to buy medicines and give her proper treatment now. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmewZ6pQs83dmCCU8XT7jYQaLtJYbw2GjkFj33mtWAq33v/image.png) We donated some HIVE from our community account to him and are setting this post beneficiary to him with 100%. I wish we had big voting powers to upvote his posts and we had options to support him more. https://images.ecency.com/DQmSqzmqSqxuRNbpX9wqjmKyhXH58FYwcK3wXaa32qnHugB/divider.png ## How you can help? - You can send liquid HIVE or HBD directly to @ybanezkim26, or you can send it to our curation account @gamingphoto (with a memo that you're sending it as donation) and we'll send it to him. - You can upvote this post which will help them as well, as 100% of this post reward will go to him. - You can reblog this post, and/or [this one](https://peakd.com/hive-188409/@ybanezkim26/life-update-my-sisters-still-in-icu), and/or [this one](https://peakd.com/hive-163772/@worldmappin/lets-support-our-beloved-team-member-ybanezkim26) or share them with your friends to let others know about it so they can help. - You can just pray for her speedy recovery if you can't donate anything atm. https://images.ecency.com/DQmSqzmqSqxuRNbpX9wqjmKyhXH58FYwcK3wXaa32qnHugB/divider.png https://images.ecency.com/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gamingphoto/23tRvMuLRERuPePNhyEjtaKt46FiKwDBgwVqqAberwmEFA36fPkh2ad6wvB1RYNKTVezR.png ***The thumbnail of this post is made in Canva and I borrowed the picture of the sister from the update post of ybanezkim26.*** 100% of this post reward has been set to @ybanezkim26 as beneficiary.
